archetypes.name: dyn-summary-parser
archetypes.rationale: Stalled summary detection now scans all lines with a tightened heading predicate.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the final-summary stalled reconciliation changes. Check that only H2 run-summary headings can trigger stalled recovery, while legacy em-dash headings remain repairable. Pay attention to interactions with committed summary checks and manifest-only reconciliation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
